name: Brightness+
description:
Brightness+ puts a brightness slider for every monitor into Quick Settings, right next to the volume slider. External monitors are controlled over DDC/CI (ddcutil), laptop screens through the backlight.

* One thin slider per monitor; hover to see its name
* Evening dimming: brightness slowly goes down after sunset (or at a set time) and comes back in the morning
* Sunset is calculated from your location, the same way Night Light does it, without extra permissions
* Extra (software) dimming when the monitor is already at its lowest
* Turn a screen off, or all the others; it wakes up when the mouse comes back
* Red screen in the Night Light menu: removes all blue and green light at night
* Fast: monitor writes are merged and never block the desktop
* Available in 18 languages

External monitors need ddcutil and access to /dev/i2c-* (i2c group). Without it, sliders fall back to software dimming.

Made by Dukha.
